name: Enterprise Competency, Qualification and Credential
constraints: Scale identity is proficiencyScaleId; ownerRef records mastership but is not identity. ScaleVersion adds immutable version.
ScaleLevel identity exists only within one ScaleVersion and has a total ordinalPosition order.
measurementLevel belongs to ScaleVersion; changing the measurement construct creates a new scale, while descriptor/order changes create a new version.
Ordinal levels permit order only; addition, subtraction, averaging, ratios and distance claims are forbidden.
missing, indeterminate, not-applicable and not-assessed are non-level outcomes and never level zero, the lowest level or a gap.
Scale and version lifecycles are custodial; effectivity is expressed through valid time.
Mappings pin both versions and endpoint levels, and endpoints must resolve in those versions.
Mappings are directional, non-transitive and never reversible without an independent reverse mapping.
Mapping loss has a non-empty residualDescription and no lossless shortcut.
Mapping authority never implies target authority endorsement.
Mappings never apply to persons or create, translate, upgrade or downgrade a Person Capability Assertion.
Finalized assessments and assertions are never recomputed against later scale versions.
Retired and superseded scales, versions, levels and mappings remain historically resolvable.
recordedAt and validFrom/validTo remain distinct; observedAt never substitutes for either.
No identifier is allocated until registry reservation; the reviewSlug carries no registry claim.
